texts.orig: Continuing a commemorative tradition that spans more than nine decades, a salvo from the Artillery's G1 gun opened the proceedings with deafening bang for the sombre remembrance of the survivors and those that laid down their lives during the war that lasted four from 1914 until the armistice in 1918. years

texts.orig: continued: "Let us honour their sacrifice and strive for a peaceful world where no innocent blood will have to be spilled, as there are so many forms of recourse to avert war and prevent conflict from escalating He also homage He paid to the South African soldiers who died pursuing peace and stability on the African continent following the country's post-1994 readmission to the international community.
